may reject unrecognized values.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description:
Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.
Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to.
Cannot be updated.
In CamelCase.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description: Specification of the numa information of the worker node

cpuDetail.description:
Specifies the cpu topology info
Key is cpu id

additionalProperties.description: CPUInfo is the cpu topology detail

numares.description:
Specifies the numa info for the resource
Key is resource name

additionalProperties.description: ResourceInfo is the sets about resource capacity and allocatable

podAllocations.description: Specifies the per-pod numa resource allocation of the node

items.description: PodAllocation records the numa resource allocation for all containers in a pod

containerAllocations.description: Specifies the per-container numa resource allocation of the pod

items.description: ContainerAllocation records the numa resource allocation for a single container

allocations.description:
Specifies the numa resource allocations of the container
Key is resource name, e.g., "cpu", "memory", "nvidia.com/gpu"
For "cpu", the value is a cpuset string, e.g., "0,2-4"
For other resources, the value is a quantity string, e.g., "2", "4Gi"

name.description: Specifies the name of the container
Specifies the name of the pod

namespace.description: Specifies the namespace of the pod

uid.description: Specifies the uid of the pod

policies.description: Specifies the policy of the manager

resReserved.description:
Specifies the reserved resource of the node
Key is resource name
